column1: # What Pyreal draws with End of Retail's own art beside an older world, and what of it the pack therefore leaves out.
# Pyreal's lists are later_rooms.rs PAIRS (room pictures) and later_models.rs MODELS (props); `cargo xtask base-pack` there
# refuses a pinned pack whose table differs from them, and build.py here refuses a material this table leaves out.
# kind: room (an older picture drawn as an End of Retail picture) or model (an older prop drawn as End of Retail's).
# id: the older picture or prop. eor: the End of Retail picture it is drawn as (room), or the same id (model).
# tinted: drawn in the older colours under Classic Ground Coloring. left out: the older eras' materials the pack
# leaves out, as era:picture; - when the pack had none, or a model the world still draws also wears the picture.
